options.name: auth_password
options.description: Set auth password of V3 trap, password is a string of 8 to 16 alpha-numeric characters. Required when I(auth_protocol) is either C(SHA) or C(MD5).

options.name: auth_protocol
options.description: Choose authentication.

options.name: community
options.description: Community of v1/v2c.

options.name: contact
options.description: Set contact, can set NULL. Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: engine_id
options.description: Set Engine ID of V3 trap, engine ID is a string of 10 to 48 hex characters, must even, can set NULL.

options.name: event_severity
options.description: Event Severity.

options.name: host
options.description: Specifies the DNS host name or address for connecting to the remote device over the specified transport.  The value of host is used as the destination address for the transport.

options.name: host_id
options.description: Host id. Only the M6 model supports this parameter.

options.name: location
options.description: Set host Location, can set NULL. Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: os
options.description: Set host OS, can set NULL. Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the password to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: priv_password
options.description: Set privacy password of V3 trap, password is a string of 8 to 16 alpha-numeric characters. Required when I(priv_protocol) is either C(DES) or C(AES).

options.name: priv_protocol
options.description: Choose Privacy.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: system_id
options.description: Set system ID, can set NULL. Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: system_name
options.description: Set system name, can set NULL. Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: trap_port
options.description: Set SNMP trap Port(1-65535). Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: username
options.description: Configures the username to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME) will be used instead.

options.name: v3username
options.description: Set user name of V3 trap.

options.name: version
options.description: SNMP trap version. Only the M6 model supports C(0) Settings.
